The article also presents the metrical principles, hardware architecture and software of the system, and a result is provided at the end.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional Imaging Information Acquisition System Based on DSP and SVM
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: In the three-dimensional imaging information acquisition system, excellent image denoising technology and high-speed information processing technology are very important and necessary. In this paper, the a new three-dimensional imaging information acquisition system based on the DSP and SVM is presented to fulfill such requirements. Among which a power macro-modeling technique for digital signal processing (DSP) system is presented to make the system have high-speed information processing and support vector machine is adopted to preprocess the image. Finally, the system is developed and the effectiveness of the system is testified.

articleTitle: Remote Uninterruptable Power Supply Monitoring over GPRS
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: The running status of Uninterruptable Power Supply (UPS) is very important factor for the safe running of devices in computer room or other application fields. In order to supervise the running status or performance of the UPS, a UPS online remote monitoring system based on general packet radio service (GPRS) network is proposed in this paper. The system could monitor the voltage, current and temperature of the UPS through the long-distance supervised terminal. The system sends the running parameter to the supervision center or mobile termination and receives the remote command from remote hand terminal or control centre by GPRS or Internet. The system could also set the alarm boundary of the voltage, current and temperature of the UPS, if the UPS appears abnormal status, the system would sent the alarm information to the mobile termination or the supervision center, as a result, the UPS could be maintained easily. The system shows the superiority in remote monitoring UPS in practice.

articleTitle: A Method of Computation Decomposition on Tightly-Nested Loop Automatic Parallelization
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: An automatic parallelization method for tightly-nested loops running on multi-core system has been proposed. First, according to the physical characteristics of multi-core processors, a way has been presented to solve the problem on dada locality during data decomposition; Second, for increasing parallel granularity of tight nested loops, the method discussed in this article studied computation decomposition based on workload, and brought forward how to compute the workload of loop iteration that can be run in parallel, and at last according to the size of the workload, determined the granularity of parallel loops to achieve to reduce the parallel overhead brought by the parallel iteration of small workload. Using this method, an automatic parallelization model based on workload can be constructed.

articleTitle: Ontology Aided Materials Service Case Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: Materials service safety is important for public security. Materials service cases are typical examples of materials service in reality. Case analysis is an efficient way for researchers and engineers to assess service safety. Traditional case analysis is manually executed by domain experts. It is time-consuming and the analysis results may be not consistent with other experts’ conclusions of similar cases. This paper proposes an ontology aided case analysis method to improve the efficiency and precision of materials service case analysis. Ontology is adopted to represent and retrieve similar cases. The reasoning mechanism of ontology is also utilized for the reasoning during case analysis. Use cases are proposed to show the obvious benefits from this method for materials service case analysis.

articleTitle: Design on Topology Algorithm of Improving the Survival Ability of Commanding Control and Communication Information System(C^3I) on Military Transportation
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: With the depth-first search algorithm of network topology to seek the key points of Commanding Control and Communication Information system(C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>I), and in conjunction with techniques of the computer program design, we can easily find the key points of the network. Start with these key points, we can improve the ability to survival and re-destroy of System(C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>I), consequently, increase its reliability.

articleTitle: Research and Application of an Online Real time Hurst Parameter Measure Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: Several methods used for measure network traffic are introduced in this paper. Hurst parameter and Characteristic of R/S algorithm are analyzed in details. An online real-time Hurst parameter measure algorithm based on R/S algorithm is proposed, and algorithm steps are demonstrated by using emulation experiment. The experiment result shows that the online real -time Hurst parameter detection algorithm can compute accurately Hurst parameter of network traffic. The network traffic measure system can dynamically adjust the sampling interval with the change of the Hurst Parameter. So, the proposed algorithm provides a basis for traffic data storing and handling.

articleTitle: Representing Financial Time Series Based on Important Extrema Points
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: This paper presents a novel method for financial time series representation. The method can generate accurate and effective representation and segmentation in different resolutions and get better experimental results on real stock data.

articleTitle: The Application of Web-Based GIS and GPS Technology to Assess Water Quality in Michigan
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: A Web-based GIS provides simplicity and interactivity such that some simplified functions of the watershed management can be open in Internet/Intranet for specific users or general public users. A palm-size GPS device provides location information, x and y coordinates, in the observation site that can bring all associate data of physical, chemical, and biological conditions. This paper presents an application of web-based GIS and GPS technology to assess water quality, by using a case study of comparing and contrasting watersheds in Michigan.

articleTitle: Research on Harmonics Suppression and Reactive Power Compensation for Power System
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: Analysis and control of power quality by neural network is a new research field in electrical power system. To avoid the deficiencies of current tracking control, this paper presents a new instantaneous current PWM control that based on neural network. Combining wtth ip-iq detecting method that based on instantaneous reactive power theory, a three-phase shunt active power filter (SAPF) for reactive power compensation and harmonic suppression that applied to power system is designed. The performance of SAPF is verified through simulation studies using Matlab. The simulation results show that the SAPF with neural network control has a good performance in harmonics suppression and reactive power compensation.

articleTitle: Research on Surface Quality Evaluation System of Steel Strip Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: An expert system of strip steel surface quality evaluation based on defect detection is proposed in this paper. Take surface defects into consideration, the expert system structure, image processing and detection processing is discussed. The software is designed with modular method to realize the function. This system can not only offer the quality evaluation reports but also provide valuable solution to avoid similar problem in the future. Furthermore, the system will rank and price the steel coil products according to the surface quality so as to prevent the dissensions caused by surface quality problems and reduce production cost.

articleTitle: Eye Location Based on Gray Projection
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: A Method, to locate eye in image by using gray projection, is presented. We utilize the gray differential projection cure of the facial image to locate eye vertically position and utilize the gray integral projection cure to locate eye horizontal position. The method can apply to not only the upright front side face, but also the upright side face, lift up face and low face. When the face in image is obliqueness, we may use blocks gray projection. So the method could process rotated images. The method is simple and its calculation is less. The experiment results show that eyes can be located quite accurately by using gray projection.

articleTitle: Application of Decision Tree Based on C4.5 in Analysis of Coal Logistics Customer
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: Customer resource is the lifeline of enterprise development, and the classification management and service for customer are very important in customer relationship management (CRM). Decision tree is one of the most popular methods for classification. In this paper, we build a decision tree based on C4.5 algorithm for coal logistics customer analysis, adopt Pessimistic Error Pruning (PEP) to simplify it and apply the rules extracted to the CRM of the coal logistics road company which shows that the method can be able to accurately classify the types of customers.

articleTitle: A Framework of CBIR System Based on Relevance Feedback
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: Content-based image retrieval (CBIR) is an effective approach for obtaining desired image, however, due to the semantic gap between low-level visual features and high-level concept of image, CBIR system of state-of-the-art always can't achieve satisfying retrieval performance. In this paper, we propose a novel CBIR system framework. In order to bridge the semantic gap, the mechanism of relevance feedback is involved in the system. More various features are included at low level, which can provide more abundant image content description. A bi-coded chromosome based genetic algorithm is performed to obtain optimal features and relevant optimal weights based on users' relevance feedback. With the optimal feature set and optimal weights, the similarity between image in original searching results and query image is considered to be the main factor of rank score.

articleTitle: A Zero-Knowledge Proof of Digital Signature Scheme Based on the Elliptic Curve Cryptosystem
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a new signature scheme based on elliptic curve cryptography. We combined the two problems, factoring and logarithm problem into both signing and verifying equations. We also give a kind of algorithm of the zero-knowledge proof of proposed digital signature. The new scheme was shown to be secure against the known attacks for signature schemes. This algorithm has characteristics which has little computation, high reliability, and easy to be realized.

articleTitle: An Improved Unascertained Approach to Construction Accident Risk Assessment and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: Construction is one of the most dangerous and risky businesses and building construction projects appear to have higher accident rates. In this paper, a new construction projects accident risk model was developed based on the unascertained number algorithm and the synthesis weights. According to human-machine engineering, the multi-index and hierarchical system of accident risk in construction projects was built and the method determining the synthesis weights of indexes including both subjective favoritism and objective information was described. Thus, qualitative knowledge and quantitative data can be integrated and quantitative change and qualitative change were to be reflected in the assessment results of accident risk in construction projects. Finally, the improved unascertained assessment approach model was constructed to assess accident risk in construction projects by combining qualitative and quantitative information over conventional or other subjective methods and was verified by a case study.

articleTitle: Amery Ice Shelf Digital Elevation Model from GLAS and GMT
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: The geoscience laser altimeter system (GLAS) on the ice cloud and land elevation satellite spacecraft provided a large amount of data on the topography of polar ice area. It is possible to create high resolution digital elevation models (DEMs) from this data by using data interpolation techniques. Five interpolation algorithms were picked to be tested on GLAS data by employing the Generic Mapping Tools and Surfer: nearest neighbor interpolation, surface, triangular, block kriging, and inverse distance to a power. These methods were applied to the GLAS data of Amery ice shelf for qualitative analysis. We calculated the mean absolute error between the interpolated DEM and the original data. Also, execution speeds were measured for the five algorithms. The surface method shows high performance both quantitatively and qualitatively to other methods tested.

articleTitle: Supervised Locally Linear Embedding in Tensor Space
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: The paper propose a new non-linear dimensionality reduction algorithm based on locally linear embedding called supervised locally linear embedding in tensor space (SLLE/T), in which the local manifold structure within same class are preserved and the separability between different classes is enforced by maximizing distance of each point with its neighbors. To keep structure of data, we introduce tensor representation and reduce SLLE/T into the optimization problem based on HOSVD which is desirable to solve the out of sample problem. We also prove SLLE/T can be united in the graph embedding framework. The comparison experiments on face recognition indicate that SLLE/T outperform most popular dimensionality reduction algorithms both vectorization and tensor version.

articleTitle: A Hybrid of Differential Evolution and Particle Swarm Optimization for Global Optimization
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: A hybrid differential evolution (HDE) approach derived from both the differential evolution (DE) and the particle swarm optimization (PSO) is proposed. In HDE, individuals in a new generation are created, not only by crossover and mutation operation as in DE, but also by PSO operations. The concepts of inertia weight and neighbor topology are adopted in HDE. The former is employed to provide consistency and diversity by adding a weighted velocity to the trial vector. In the latter, instead of the whole population, each individual can only communicate with its neighbors, and each individual creates its trial vector based on the best individual found by its neighbors so far. The proposed approach is employed for four well-known benchmarks, and the simulation results have shown its feasibility and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of UKF for Nonlinear Problems
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: Unscented Kalman filter (UKF) is a class of nonlinear filtering methods based on unscented transform within the Kalman filter framework. It is in light of the intuition that to approximate a probability distribution by a set of deterministic samples is easier than to approximate an arbitrary nonlinear transform. The key factors of UKF-the scalar, the state variable dimensions and the noises involved in nonlinear system, besides the probability distribution, should be synthetically analyzed. The mean square error is adopted to evaluate the effect of these factors on the performance of UKF. The simulation results show that the factors above mentioned more or less affect the performance of UKF, in which the state noise plays the most important role.

articleTitle: A Novel Vehicle Detection Method Based on Wireless Magneto-resistive Sensor
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: In recent years, vehicles detection base on the magnetic effect is a major hot spot in the field of vehicles detection. This paper has studied and realized a wireless magneto-resistive sensor based vehicles detection system, and improved the vehicle detection algorithm. The thesis has used a testing algorithm based on iterative optimal wavelet threshold used to focus on testing whether vehicles passing by. For the speed detection, the traditional algorithm of speed detection has been improved; a new speed detection method which is based on clock synchronization has been used. In that way the error of speed detection will be minimized. The effectiveness of the algorithms has been tested by using the vehicle detection signals of wireless magneto-resistive sensors. Experimental result shows that, the vehicle detection algorithms are available for the vehicles detection and the speed measurement.

articleTitle: Using Dynamic Semantic Network to Construct Knowledge Base
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: Knowledge base building is a key branch of modern artificial intelligence research. Current methods in this field mainly focus on computational efficiency, decidability, data exchange, and machine readability. In this paper, a novel human like knowledge representation method called dynamic semantic network (DSN) is proposed. With the inspiration of high level human brain cognitive models, DSN aims at building more practical and abundant knowledge base. The inference and learning mechanism on DSN are latterly studied. And the construction issues are also discussed.

articleTitle: Research on Embedded Electro-hydraulic Proportional Valve Controller
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: In this paper, a high-performance electro-hydraulic proportional valve controller is designed and developed by using embedded-computer technology. Based on the analysis of the work principle and control requirements, authors present a structure of the controller and its control strategy, and its design and program method are discussed in detail. This controller has advantages such as simplicity, powerful function, flexibility and high performance price ratio, has been a renewal product and affords a new choice for users in industry.

Author Keywords: embedded technology proportional control pwm hydraulic system proportional valve

articleTitle: Three Evaluation Method of Modular Products
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: Modular product evaluation is one of key technologies in modular design. Three kinds of evaluation methods, which based on three modular design styles, were proposed in this paper. These methods integrated customer satisfaction index (CSI), product customization index (PCI) or modularity degree index (MDI). Then several modularization customized products can be evaluated. Some customer satisfaction factors were discussed. The CSI was gained via separately counting the price and delivery time factors from the other factors. PCI, which was the total customization cost and its proportion, was counted, moreover, the customization cost was divided into design customization cost, manufacture customization cost and assembly customization cost, respectively. The MDI was counted with product design structure matrix (DSM). Finally, an example was presented to show the feasibility of the proposed approaches.

articleTitle: Application of Data Mining in Production Quality Management
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: Application of data mining in manufacturing enterprises' quality management is introduced. Quality factor analysis is very important for quality control and production management. In this article, based on Rough Set theory an improved Apriori algorithm is put forward to mine quantitative relationship among different factors which influence product quality. The improved algorithm overcomes the traditional Apriori algorithm's limitation of qualitative analysis.

articleTitle: Extensionally Completed L-measure Based on any Given Fuzzy Measure
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: The well known fuzzy measures, ¿-measure and P-measure, both of them have only one formulaic solution. A multivalent fuzzy measure with infinitely many solutions was proposed by our previous work, called L-measure, but it is not a completed measure. After that, an improved completed measure with more many solutions than L-measure, called complete L-measure, was also proposed by the author. In this paper, the extensionally completed L-measure is proposed. Some properties of this new measure are discussed, it is proved that not only ¿-measure and P-measure but also any given fuzzy measures are the special cases of this new measure. For evaluating the Choquet integral regression models with our proposed new measures and other different ones, a real data experiment by using a 5-fold cross-validation mean square error (MSE) is conducted. The performances of Choquet integral regression models with fuzzy measure based on completed L-measure, L-measure, ¿-measure and P-measure, respectively, a ridge regression model and a multiple linear regression model are compared. Experimental result shows that the Choquet integral regression model with respect to the new measure outperforms other forecasting models.

articleTitle: A Design of Communication Equipment Simulator Based on ARM and Finite-State Machine
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: The design based on ARM techniques is to realize a common model of communication equipment simulator. The S3C2410 chip, as the core of hardware, together with FPGA and other interface circuits, realize standardized coding and display controlling; the backstage computer software as a finite-state machine, need to give correct operating response, send display orders, communicate with other simulator. While applied to simulate various equipments, the only difference is customized equipment panel and computer software according to the real equipment response. It has been proved that the transplantable design is practical for the simulating of communication equipments.

articleTitle: A Novel Quantum Genetic Algorithm for Area Optimization of FPRM Circuits
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: This paper proposes a novel quantum genetic algorithm (NQGA) to search for the best polarity of fixed-polarity RM (FPRM) circuits with the objective of minimizing the area. In order to improve stability of the traditional quantum generic algorithm and its ability to search the global optima, even evolution is employed to update the qubit chromosomes, and reproduction as well as crossover operators are introduced into the algorithm. Experimental results of eight circuits from MCNC benchmark show that the proposed algorithm is superior to the traditional quantum genetic algorithm in both search capacity and optimization efficiency.

articleTitle: An Electronic Marketplace Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: To improve the efficiency of auction-based negotiation system in e-marketplace, this paper presents a model of game agent for auction-based negotiation, a bid negotiation algorithm based on game theory and a framework of game-based electronic marketplace. It provides a new effective way to establish buyer game agents for making buyer agent bid more rationally and a game negotiation agent system for e-marketplace. Experiments show that the new way has achieved good results.

articleTitle: An Architecture for Web Based and Distributed Telecommunication Network Management System
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract: The rapidly development of the network scale, complexity and heterogeneity in telecommunication network significantly increased the difficulty for the work of network management. This paper proposed a new kind of architecture for constructing Web based and distributed telecommunication network management system. The architecture is constructed by a group of servers, such as the back end server, the front end server, management server, and NMS API services. The network management system is based on the J2EE and EJB technologies that allow all the parts of the network management system to be located on separate computers located in different location. The whole network management system is partitioned into small pieces. A prototype of the practical telecommunication network management system has been implemented according the architecture. The experiments show that the architecture can be used to construct web based NMS to manage to manage large-scale network system.

articleTitle: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: Optimal Control of Chaotic System Based on LS-SVM with Mixed Kernel
publicationTitle: 2009 Third International Symposium on Intelligent Information Technology Application
abstract:
